findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_balance, get_portfolio, get_token_info, get_token_price, get_swap_quote, get_allowance, get_nft, get_gas, get_block, get_block_at_time, get_transaction, decode_tx_logs, decode_calldata, detect_proxy, resolve_ens, get_ens_records, check_sanctions · Private data: get_balance, get_portfolio, get_token_info, get_token_price, get_allowance, get_nft, decode_calldata, detect_proxy, resolve_ens, get_ens_records, check_contract_before_interaction · Public sink: get_balance, get_portfolio, get_token_info, get_token_price, get_swap_quote, get_allowance, get_nft, get_gas, get_block, get_block_at_time, get_transaction, decode_tx_logs, decode_calldata, detect_proxy, resolve_ens, get_ens_records, check_contract_before_interaction, check_sanctions.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
